name: claudin
description: Live official docs for Claude Code, claude.ai/Cowork, the Claude API, MCP, ACP, OpenAI/Codex and xAI/Grok via seven authless docs MCPs, with docs-lookup preferring docs connectors over web fetches when available. Builder skills: plugin-dev (plugins for Claude, Codex, Grok Build, Copilot CLI, Antigravity, Gemini CLI), mcp-dev (MCP servers and Apps, OAuth, MCPB, directory review) and skill-creator-v2 (skill lifecycle, evals, packaging).

interface.longDescription: Ask about Claude Code, claude.ai, the Claude API, MCP, the Agent Client Protocol, OpenAI/Codex or xAI/Grok and docs-lookup answers from the live official docs, with links: seven bundled docs MCP servers, no setup. For builders: plugin-dev packages skills, MCP servers and Claude Code extras into plugins for Claude chat, Cowork, Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Grok Build, GitHub Copilot CLI, Google Antigravity and Gemini CLI; mcp-dev designs, tests and ships MCP servers and MCP Apps (deployment, tool design, OAuth, MCPB, directory review, the stateless 2026-07-28 spec, a stdlib probe script); skill-creator-v2 runs the skill lifecycle. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie; not an official Anthropic, OpenAI or xAI plugin. Includes OpenAI plugin and MCP App scaffolding, static validation, and focused API/Codex references.
